title: RuleSmith: Multi-Agent LLMs for Automated Game Balancing
abstract: arXiv:2602.06232v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Game balancing is a longstanding challenge requiring repeated playtesting, expert intuition, and extensive manual tuning. We introduce RuleSmith, a framework that couples multi-agent LLM self-play with surrogate-based optimization over a parameterized rule space. As a proof of concept, we build CivMini, a simplified civilization-style game with two asymmetric factions governed by 12 tunable parameters. LLM agents interpret textual rulebooks and game states to propose actions that are validated by the game engine, yielding noisy estimates of faction win rates. Our primary implementation uses Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization with Expected-Improvement-based adaptive sampling to allocate more evaluation games to promising candidates. translated_title: RuleSmith：用于自动化游戏平衡的多智能体大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: 游戏平衡是一个长期存在的挑战，需要反复的游戏测试、专家直觉和大量的人工调优。我们提出了RuleSmith，这是一个将多智能体大语言模型自博弈与基于代理模型的优化相结合、作用于参数化规则空间的框架。作为概念验证，我们构建了CivMini，一个简化的文明风格游戏，其中包含由12个可调参数控制的两个非对称阵营。大语言模型智能体解读文本形式的规则手册和游戏状态，提出行动建议，这些行动由游戏引擎验证，从而产生带噪声的阵营胜率估计。我们的主要实现采用高斯过程贝叶斯优化，并配合基于期望改进的自适应采样，将更多评估对局分配给有前景的候选配置。RuleSmith始终能够找到接近平衡的配置：三次独立的优化运行在独立的200局和300局评估中均达到了接近均衡的经验胜率，此外的实验进一步……
tldr: RuleSmith框架将多智能体大语言模型自博弈与高斯过程贝叶斯优化相结合，在参数化的规则空间中自动搜索游戏平衡配置，并在简化的文明风格游戏CivMini上实现了接近均衡的双阵营胜率。
en_tdlr: RuleSmith couples multi-agent LLM self-play with Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization to automatically find near-balanced game rule configurations, demonstrated on CivMini, a simplified civilization-style game with two asymmetric factions.
